Paul George is 36 years old.

Where was Paul George born?

Paul George was born in Palmdale, California.

When was Paul George born?

Paul George was born on May 2, 1990.

How tall is Paul George?

Paul George is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much does Paul George weigh?

Paul George weighs 220 lbs (99 kg).

Is Paul George in the Hall of Fame?

Paul George is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Paul George drafted?

Paul George was drafted by Indiana Pacers, 1st round (10th pick, 10th overall), 2010 NBA Draft.

Small Forward, Power Forward, and Shooting Guard.

Paul George made $51,666,090 in 2026.

Paul George has won 0 championships.

What schools did Paul George attend?

Paul George attended Knight in Palmdale, California and Fresno State.

What are Paul George's nicknames?
